title: always thought institutional grade execution required a prime brokerage relationship.
author: Left-District-2493
selftext:
ok so spent quite a long time now assuming the execution quality which is there to institutional desks was just not accessible without the right acc size and the right relationships . minimum deposits and the whole setup that exists to keep retail on a diff tier

been running on an sdk for a while now andd the execution is on par with what institutional desks get . they dont have a tiered system where account size determines fill quality . same execution for everyone because it is all going onchain and pricing is derived from tradfi markets directly ,

the access that used to require a prime brokerage introduction is just. there. most people building systematic strategies on retail platforms do not know this exists yet.

what are you guys using??

comments.author: LowRevolutionary539
comments.body: I'm quite new to this to still figuring out my stuff lol
